newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia dips but Merita, UPM lift thin Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Nokia dips but Merita, UPM lift thin Helsinki.

text.p: Helsinki trades a shade higher in midsession on gains in forestry group UPM-Kymmene and banking group Merita. Nokia falls slightly.
Merita advanced on an outperformer rating from U.S investment bank Goldman Sachs. Sampo added 5.00 markka trading to 510.00, extending gains on Monday.

UPM was up 2.20 markka trading at 122.20. "It corrects Monday's dip with other forestries," one broker said. There was also speculation about what UPM will do with the money from its sale of 4.5 million Nokia shares on which it will book a 1.5 billion markka pretax capital gain.

Kemira rose in relatively healthy trade, adding 2.20 markka to 51.20. "It has been underestimated compared to the general index and also compared to the shares in the similar kinds of international companies," one broker said.
Another broker said Kemira would not go much further. "I believe it will stabilise around 50.00 markka," she said.
